code:
Reasoning only  -> can talk itself into a confident wrong
                   answer, no check against reality
Acting only     -> no record of WHY a choice was made,
                   hard to debug a wrong one mid-task
ReAct (both)    -> each Thought grounded in the latest
                   real Observation
caption: Yao et al., 2022 — "ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting."

eyebrow: A real trace, Thought by Thought
code:
Thought: need the company name for this ticker first.
Action: get_company_info(ticker="NVDA")
Observation: {name: "NVIDIA", founded: 1993}

Thought: now need NVIDIA's IPO date.
Action: get_ipo_date(company="NVIDIA")
Observation: {ipo_date: "1999-01-22"}

Thought: 1993 to 1999 -- 6 years. Done.
caption: Each Thought depends directly on the Observation before it.

eyebrow: A style, not a new mechanism
code:
No new API fields. In the Claude API, "Thought" shows up as:
  - narration text alongside a tool_use block (Lesson 7), or
  - an explicit extended-thinking block

It's how you prompt and structure the loop, not a new shape.
caption: ReAct is applied on top of the loop Lesson 2 already taught.
